name: Website Show Price After Login
description: Website Show Price After Login lets you hide product prices from visitors until they log in. This helps you control who sees your pricing, making it ideal for B2B websites or member-only stores. Create a personalized shopping experience by showing prices only to registered users
summary:
Website Show Price After Login is a powerful tool that lets you hide product prices from guest visitors and display them only to logged-in users. This feature is perfect for B2B websites, wholesale stores, or any business that wants to offer exclusive pricing to registered customers. By requiring users to log in before viewing prices, you create a more personalized and secure shopping experience. It also helps control who can access your pricing information, protecting your business from competitors or unwanted viewers. The app is easy to set up and works seamlessly with your existing store. Whether you want to offer special prices to certain users or simply keep your pricing private, this app gives you full control. Improve user engagement, boost conversions, and maintain better pricing transparency with Website Show Price After Login. Ideal for businesses that value privacy, customization, and user management.

description: Enhance your Odoo Point of Sale system with the "Hide Out of Stock Products" module.
